description: Rotating the top layout control 90 degrees about Z (it sits at the origin) carries the start, handle and pole child plugs rigidly: (x,y) goes to (-y,x). mid (1.8,2.4,0) -> (-2.4,1.8,0), end (5,0,0) -> (0,5,0), pole (2.5,5,0) -> (-5,2.5,0), settings (0,8,0) -> (-8,0,0), and every joint turns 90 degrees.
